title: Indoor LoRaWAN multi-environment dataset and analysis code (v2.2)
description: Raw measurement dataset (43,100 LoRaWAN uplink packets, four indoor environments: residential apartment, research laboratory, multi-floor building, underground industrial facility), MATLAB scripts for the radio link characterization, and the Python notebook for the machine learning classification, accompanying the paper "Empirical Characterization and Machine Learning-Based Classification of Indoor LoRaWAN Propagation Environments" (Discover Internet of Things).
